title: Table
description: A data table of invoices, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Checkbox, Menu, Pagination and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a short description, a toolbar with the invoice count that turns into the selection count with a "Clear selection" Button and a "Bulk actions" Menu once rows are selected, then a table with a Checkbox per row and one for the page, sortable Invoice, Customer and Amount headers, a status Badge and an actions Menu on each row, and a Pagination row under it, with its own loading, empty and error renders; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame when the container is narrower than its columns, and responds to its container (@container) — the page row moves to the end at @sm, the heading steps up at @md, and the Issued column appears, each customer's email shows under the name and the section gains room above and below at @lg.
